title: SecretUseRequest
description: network.secret-use-request@1 (ADR-056): what a first-party service sends to POST /internal/secrets/use with network.secret.use. sign asks for HMAC-SHA256 of message under the secret (the value never leaves Network); reveal asks for the value, to send to origin. Either needs a grant of that secret to the calling service for that purpose (and origin).

message.description: sign: the exact text to sign (for a webhook delivery, "<timestamp>.<raw body>"). Not allowed with reveal.

origin.description: reveal: the https origin the value will be sent to; the grant must list it. Not allowed with sign.
